title: Codex Task Result
description: Structured result from a Codex execution task. Produced by Codex after processing a task capsule, consumed by the GSD executor to determine next steps.

status.description: Task outcome. 'complete' = task done and committed. 'failed' = unrecoverable error, no commit. 'checkpoint' = Rule 4 triggered, architectural decision needed.

files_changed.description: Relative paths of all files created or modified by this task. Empty array if no files changed (e.g., on failure before any writes).

tests_passed.description: Result of running the verify command from the task definition. true if exit code 0, false otherwise.

test_output_summary.description: Brief summary of test/verify output (e.g., '12 tests passed', 'FAIL: expected 3, got 5'). Null if no tests were run.

deviations.description: Deviation entries in '[Rule N - Type] description' format. Empty array if task executed exactly as specified.

commit_hash.description: Short git commit hash (7+ hex chars) from the task commit. Null if no commit was made (failed before committing).

error_message.description: Human-readable error description when status is 'failed'. Null on success or checkpoint.

checkpoint_detail.description: Description of the architectural decision needed when status is 'checkpoint' (Rule 4). Null on success or failure.

examples.test_output_summary: FAIL: expected JWT token, got undefined
deviations: [Rule 1 - Bug] Fixed null check on token parse
examples.error_message: Tests fail after 3 fix attempts — token validation requires upstream schema change

examples.checkpoint_detail: Task requires new database table for session storage — architectural decision needed
